Listeners rate each generated sentence on a 1‑5 Likert scale for naturalness (MOS) and compare pairs for preference (CMOS).

For MOS, each evaluator is asked to mark the subjective naturalness of a sentence on a 1-5 Likert scale. For CMOS, listeners are asked to compare pairs of audio generated by systems A and B and indicate which of the two audio they prefer and choose one of the following scores: 0 indicating no difference, 1 indicating small difference, 2 indicating a large difference and 3 indicating a very large difference.
